title: Continuation choices, reciprocal return and intentional loops
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full actual owner review; internal accepted-direction supersession and proposed transition implementation distinguished
reviews.disposition:
F1: All676 current lines reviewed, including CA1–CA7/CA13/CA14, P1–P5/C1–C5/E1–E5/S1–S5, SC1–SC5, FL/PFL, CCH-AR/AU, WT1–WT6/OM1–OM7/FC1–FC3, RL1–RL5 and YAS-C1–C7. The document contains its own supersession: continuing-self memories/base cheat, guided randomness, initial replay/fresh continuation, first authored checkpoint upgrade, unconscious-choice access and ordinary reciprocal A/B return are selected direction at their linked scope. Older no-answer/awaiting-starting-access/return-still-open text remains chronology. Do not ask those questions again or add a mandatory research unlock for WT5. Proposals for schema, automatic relocation and every possible embodiment remain separate.

F2: A fresh guided life normally uses a separate history and pauses the former one; reciprocal return restores its living departure embodiment while retaining current journey memory/usable learning/base-cheat growth through actual means. Paused archive, remembered destination, currently operative route, dead body and record-only chronicle differ. Source metadata, world-instance construction, heir-save builder, ended-life archive and scenario rewind do not individually implement that whole switch. OM source observations and CP chat reservations are dated, not a fresh code audit, live file lease or authority to resume another worker.

F3: Preserve one coherent durable switch across actual owners, exact departure jobs/clocks and current journey authority. No partial publication, accidental reroll, duplicated reward/bank or replayed callback on failed storage/retry. Intentional new loop attempts are distinct from handling the same event twice; D27 permits them. Host yielding/stop is technical responsiveness, not a lore repetition cap or guaranteed escape. Native unconscious recovery, choice access, choice presentation, automatic relocation and actual terminal-body return are different. A real suppression mechanism can act; generic danger tags and invented activation fees cannot replace the chosen faculty's terms.

F4: Soul/body/faculty/mastery/custody, external ledger claims, comfort preferences and historical knowledge have distinct owners. Retained learning need not grant unusable physical power, and changing bodies need not erase actual expertise. Unknown facts, host memories, enemy identity and sealed clauses remain observer-qualified; actual powerful means may reveal or remove more. SC binding benefits/burdens are not automatic curses, cleansing, debt transfer to every counterpart or new restrictions invented to defeat escape. Cancellation/navigation is not a commit or temporal power. Genuine creation/duplication remains possible through declared means, without accidental storage duplication becoming such a power.

F5: P1–P5, enemy perspectives, succession, same-world time and YAS-C1–C7 retain useful alternatives without changing current build order. Player campaign selection differs from a character carrying themselves/knowledge/items across time or worlds. A former controlled person remains an actor under actual state, not an automatic boss. The You Are Summoned row is attributed source evidence, not a universal home-healing, three-clock, carry or contract rule. Its stated Books1–5 read belongs to that source receipt, not a fresh source read here. Old one-prestige automation wording does not restore the retired milestone gate.

F6: PFL5/WT/automatic-handling surfaces and1366×768 targets are historical proposals; current desktop/design/UI owners and AD36/AD43 govern selected proof. AD42 makes human review optional; AR6/current compatibility owner qualifies blanket old-save requirements. Actual lossy caps, pruning, retained-gain changes or incompatible migration need concrete measured decisions, not speculative new blockers. No history cap, global forced loss, new source acquisition, private-save access, runtime edit, browser/build, worker/message, migration, commit or push occurred. Preserve chronology and the exact selected-versus-proposed distinction rather than replacing mixed history with a stub.
reviews.evidence: All676 current lines read sequentially in seven untruncated bounded chunks; linked execution/source records not reopened by association.
reviews.reopen: Only changed owner text or a selected concrete transition requires current source/evidence/compatibility work; continue wider intake.
